senses.gloss:
ITA-3.16.33 indrabastiḥ (marma) इन्द्रबस्तिः (मर्म)
Vulnerable location(s) in the calf muscles
Four in number (one in each limb) which when injured causes severe bleeding leading to death.

ITA-5.62.25 indraluptaḥ/ rūhyā इन्द्रलुप्तः, रुह्या
Morbid baldness affecting scalp hair
A disorder characterized by hair loss; absence of hair regrowth in same area.

ITA-5.62.8 indraviddhā इन्द्रविद्धा
Skin lesions with many small central vesicles resembling lotus fruit seeds
A disorder characterized by a conglomeration of numerous papular lesions resembling the carpellary, receptacle and seed capsules of lotus flower.

ITA-3.10.1 indriyam, akṣam इन्द्रियम्, अक्षम्
The motor or sensory faculty
A term that usually refers to the sense organs.

ITA-1.9.3.3.5 indriyāntara-sañcāraḥ इन्द्रियान्तर-सञ्चारः
Trans-sense migration
The rapid conjugation of mind with the sensory or motor organs.
